incident_text: Enterprise admins cannot login after a bad MFA policy rollout; support opened a sev-1 incident for org-wide lockout.
action_description: Toggle org-wide MFA enforcement off for 30 minutes and push emergency session policy to all IdP clients
reversibility_plan: Re-enable MFA from known-good policy snapshot, revoke emergency sessions, and verify login metrics before closing
scope_boundary: single customer org tenant, break-glass window only

resource_limits.rate_limit: policy push limited to staged cohorts

kill_path_capabilities.throttle: policy push rate can be reduced to halt further rollout
kill_path_capabilities.degrade: IdP can serve deny-all except break-glass role
kill_path_capabilities.isolate: affected tenant can be split to dedicated IdP pool
kill_path_capabilities.hard_stop: emergency policy workflow can be aborted by incident commander token

rollback_plan: Restore MFA enforcement from snapshot, invalidate emergency sessions, preserve audit logs, and notify security owner.
